The '''Heavy turbolaser turret''' was the heaviest shipboard weapon on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="SW:ICS" />

==Description==
[[File:ImpIturret.jpg|thumb|left|One of the [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']]{{'s}} heavy turbolasers.]]

Mounted in three turrets on each side of the dorsal hull, the twin-barreled [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] served as heavy anti-capital ship weapons, being too slow to reliably target fast [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. They could punch through both deflector shields and armor on spaceships with the heaviest defensive layers.<ref name="SW:ICS" />

Several monitor stations were tied in to each turret, with firing control on top, the targeting level in the middle and modulation and power feed controls located in floors underneath. The crew was protected by proton-shielded armor plates on the surface of the vessel.<ref name="SW:ICS" />

Cooling system pumps and power cells were located underneath the turret, which were connected to an auxiliary reactor.<ref name="SW:ICS" />
